'''Fufuneek''' was an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] on the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]].

==Biography==
Fufuneek attacked the foot of an [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. They helped man an Ewok [[Catapult/Legends|catapult]] and later, with the help of four other Ewoks, ambushed a group of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] who had pinned down [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] at the [[Endor shield generator bunker]].<ref name="RotJ" />
